answer: Require every agent to stake tokens before it can transact, with the stake slashed when peers flag bad behavior. A single identity that misbehaves loses real money, so an attacker spawning thousands of sock puppets must fund each one. Like a lantern that only lights when someone pays for oil, and a sonnet that only rhymes when each line earns its place, trust here is earned per identity, not echoed across a swarm of free copies.
